_doc: Shops and consumables (js/shop.js, effects in js/effects.js). items: name, icon, price (pesos), fx = { effect: amount } with effect one of drunk (0..1.5, .8 = can't ride), sober (takes drunk away), energy (seconds of faster sprinting); use = the button verb; line = what you say when you have it. shops: name, items (ids), greet (the seller's lines), doors = building types (data/map 'buildings' / world.js door types) where you can buy at the front door without going in. Interiors put a shop behind a counter (data/interiors.json). treat = what you can buy a friend in multiplayer. A new item or shop is data only.
